mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_location (user_id, activity_id, latitude, longitude, address, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityId}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{address}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE latitude = VALUES(latitude), longitude = VALUES(longitude), address = VALUES(address), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT ul.id, ul.user_id, ul.activity_id, ul.latitude, ul.longitude, ul.address, ul.update_time, u.nickname FROM user_location ul LEFT JOIN user u ON ul.user_id = u.id WHERE ul.activity_id = #{activityId} AND ul.update_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) ORDER BY ul.update_time DESC

SELECT ul.id, ul.user_id, ul.activity_id, ul.latitude, ul.longitude, ul.address, ul.update_time, u.nickname FROM user_location ul LEFT JOIN user u ON ul.user_id = u.id WHERE ul.user_id = #{userId} AND ul.activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_location WHERE update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
